# monotaur_role (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur role. Roles define a named set of permissions that can be assigned to service accounts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_role" "monitor_editor" {
  name        = "monitor-editor"
  description = "Can create and update monitors but cannot delete them"
  permissions = [
    "monitors:read",
    "monitors:create",
    "monitors:update",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) The list of permission strings granted by this role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the role (assigned by the API).
